title: npm Granular access token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: delimiter npm- (the pre-2021 hyphen) vs the documented underscore delimiter. Twin of "npm Granular access token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of npm-token-access-plain: boundary: delimiter npm- (the pre-2021 hyphen) vs the documented underscore delimiter. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
